story: Paavai Vilaku reimagines the traditional paavai vilakku as a dramatic suspended lighting composition. Multiple hanging frames descend from a large circular canopy, each enclosing a figurative paavai form along with warm glowing light elements, creating a layered interplay of sculpture, illumination, and movement.
tagline: A circle of light, framed by the grace of the paavai.
name: Paavai Vilaku
